title: German Chronic Hand Eczema Registry
official: German Registry for Chronic Hand Eczema
summary: HEBest is a prospective, non-interventional German patient registry for adults with moderate-to-severe chronic hand eczema who are initiating treatment recommended for use in routine clinical care. Treatment decisions are made jointly by the treating dermatologist and patient.The registry does not assign or modify treatment. It collects physician-reported clinical data and patient-reported outcomes through electronic case report forms and questionnaires. The registry aims to describe treatment patterns, disease severity and course, treatment response, health-related quality of life, patient-reported treatment benefit, and safety in routine dermatological care.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* • Age 18 years or older.

  * Diagnosis of chronic hand eczema made by a dermatologist.
  * Moderate-to-severe chronic hand eczema according to the applicable German guideline and checklist for advanced therapies.
  * Sufficient German or English language skills to understand the study information and provide informed consent.
  * Written informed consent before registry inclusion.
  * Initiation of a treatment recommended for chronic hand eczema in routine care, as described in the protocol.

Exclusion Criteria:

* No written informed consent.
* Participation in a clinical trial for chronic hand eczema at the time of registry inclusion. The protocol notes that data may be documented separately for a clinical trial begun during registry follow-up.
* Any medical or non-medical reason that interferes with participation in the observational registry.
